analytic_1D.formula: Audited source scattering and full_target_reflection unchanged
analytic_1D.equality_reason: Existing half-wave slab/PEC compensation at fixed reference and center frequency; not equality at other frequencies or a 2D wall result.

analytic_1D.claim_limit: Existing analytic 1D two-atom control only; not the new 2D finite material prior or general wall result.
